workbook_task.title: Run the matched learned QPAF pilot
workbook_task.deliverable: Approved matched QPAF checkpoint, predictions, manifest and telemetry

purpose: Train the matched learned QPAF pilot (query-page gate) on the same sealed M3.1 inputs, frozen config and seed as the accepted M3.2 QARF run, select the checkpoint on validation, and retain checkpoints, predictions, metrics, telemetry and provenance for the M3.5 per-query comparison and the M3.6 integrity review.
claim_scope: QPAF development-seed training evidence on train/validation only. No test labels. No QPAF-versus-QARF claim (that is M3.5) and no baseline claim. Not a scientific_result until M3.5/M3.6 review and G2.

comparator.matching_rule: configs/m2.7/matched.json (sealed copy inputs/matched.json): only gate_granularity may differ. The supervisor refuses unless sealed_inputs, config, metric, runtime, hardware, the shared limits and the seed equal the QARF authorization, and the command equals the QARF command with only --method and the output root replaced.

git.code_base_description: develop after merge of PR #26 (M3.3 independent QARF validation)
git.tracked_state_policy: At run start, git diff --name-only against code_base_commit must list only paths under allowed_diff_from_base, and git status --porcelain must show no modified tracked files.

sealed_inputs.candidate_definition: M2.8-002 top-document expansion (A003, post hoc), page-level, cap 600, macro candidate recall 1.0, zero uncovered queries

method.name: QPAF
method.note: The method is NOT part of the resolved config (the config has no method key); it is selected only by --method. The resolved config is therefore byte-identical to the QARF run, and the command binds the method explicitly.

config.semantic_parent: configs/m2.7/shared_base.toml (matched.json: only gate_granularity may differ between QARF and QPAF)

frozen_values.selection_metric: ndcg_at_10 (validation only; ties keep the earlier epoch)

config.expected_hash_basis: Computed before the run with qpaf.m24.config.load_config + qpaf.m11.artifacts.write_json/object_hash; the run's resolved_config.json and provenance.json must reproduce these exactly.

limits.wall_time_enforcement: Enforced by the supervisor: the whole process tree is killed at wall_time_seconds and the attempt is marked FAILED with reason wall_time_exceeded.
limits.retry_rule: A fresh attempt needs a reviewed reason, a new run_id (A02) with retry_of set to the prior run_id, a new namespace and a new authorization.
limits.wall_time_basis: Same 60-minute budget as QARF (matched.json budget.shared_by_methods). The QARF run took 75.4 s; on the synthetic fixture QPAF trained in 1.56 s against 1.64 s for QARF.

output.create_once_rule: The supervisor refuses when the namespace root already exists and creates _ATTEMPTED.json exclusively before starting the runner, so a second invocation is refused even after a failure. The runner alone would allow a retry after a failed attempt.

required_markers.note: The supervisor writes the _ATTEMPTED/_SUCCESS markers named in run_policy.md section 4.

invocation: <pin recorded outside this file at approval>
supervisor.source_note: src/qpaf/m34/supervisor.py reuses the M3.2 single-attempt helpers from src/qpaf/m32/supervisor.py, which is unchanged and keeps the hash pinned by the M3.2 authorization.

exit_codes.0: run completed and passed every post-run check

supervisor.validity_rule: A run is valid evidence only if its namespace holds _ATTEMPTED.json, supervisor.log and exactly one of _SUCCESS.json/_FAILED.json written by this supervisor. The runner can be launched without the supervisor, so M3.5 and M3.6 must reject any run that lacks them.
supervisor.actor_rule: The --actor value must equal the actor field above; the supervisor refuses on any mismatch and when this field is still PENDING.

stop_conditions: source, config, data or hash drift from this manifest
pre-run verification of the M3.1 seal fails
split overlap, candidate-key mismatch, missing query or qrels leakage
development coverage below 0.95 or a query with no positive candidate
non-finite loss, gradient, parameter or metric; or checkpoint reload parity above 1e-7
wall time above limits.wall_time_seconds, or any resource, memory or telemetry violation
namespace already exists, or any actor, invocation, retry or approval mismatch
the QARF comparator lacks its accepted M3.3 review, or this authorization differs from it in anything but the method
the finished run consumed inputs or rows that differ from the QARF run
pre_run_checks: scripts/seal_m31_inputs.py --verify <run_path> --expected-manifest-sha256 <manifest_sha256> exits 0 immediately before the run
the QARF authorization, data_manifest.json and provenance.json match comparator pins, and event QPAF-REG-20261022-0022 records ACCEPTANCE_RECORDED / PASS for that run
this authorization equals the QARF one in every shared section; only method and output root differ
post_run_checks: provenance.json source.git_commit equals git_head recorded in _ATTEMPTED.json
data_manifest.json shows the test split as not_opened and summary.json reload_parity.passed is true
data_manifest.json SHA-256 equals comparator.data_manifest_sha256 (same rows, order and counts)
provenance.json inputs equal the QARF run inputs, and summary.json names QPAF, page and seed 20260820
the namespace holds only _ATTEMPTED.json, supervisor.log, the QPAF stage and the final marker
